text:
jen wong: FYI acme-fintech asked if we can demonstrate graceful backpressure on streaming SDKs. They want to stream 1000 rows with occasional spikes, and the frontend must render rows as they arrive.
omar khan: We typically recommend NDJSON over websockets or SSE; both support incremental objects. Backpressure handled client-side by ack tokens or by using small chunk sizes.
lucy chen: For spikes, suggest adaptive batching on the server: detect high qps and shift from per-token flush to 256-token micro-batches. That reduces upstream pressure but increases tail latency slightly.
jen wong: Customer also insists on function/tool calls that can synchronously query their payments index. Can we guarantee ordering between tool_call events and streamed text fragments?
omar khan: We emit tool_call events as distinct NDJSON messages: {"event":"tool_call","id":"xyz","payload":{...}} then the model emits the tool result as separate chunks. Ordering preserved by stream sequence. If they need strictly atomic pairing, we can wrap tool result and associated text in a single object per row.
lucy chen: Note: some frontends choke if a chunk isn't valid JSON. Recommend schema: each message is an object with a type field: type in ["row","tool_call","meta","done"] so consumer can switch.
frank_sales: Procurement Q: They want pricing for hosted trial (30 days) at sustained 50k tokens/day and also a committed dedicated 3-month POC. Need two numbers + a note about pool sizing.
jen wong: Finance ballpark: hosted: $0.003 / token typical for high-quality models at scale (we can discount for trial). Dedicated POC: starts at $25k/month for minimal pool (1-2 GPUs) and scales; effective token price ~40% lower after commit. Confirm with devon.
lucy chen: Security asks: SAML SSO, IP allowlist, SOC2 Type II report, KMS/BYOK. Private/VPC needed for KMS BYOK. For hosted trial we can offer ephemeral keys + isolated project and audit logs.
omar khan: For SAML, we need IdP metadata and ACS URL. Warn customer our SAML requires entityID to be unique (some SAML providers generate dynamic entityIDs which breaks our import).
jen wong: Timeline question: can we run hosted streaming + function calls demo within 5 business days and stand up Private POC in ~2 weeks?
lucy chen: Yes hosted demo in 3-5 days if they provide sample dataset and tool API contract. Private POC depends on infra scheduling, 10-14 business days realistic.
infra-bot: env create request queued: acme-poc-hosted-demo (ETA 72h)
jen wong: Action items: 1) Omar to draft tiny NDJSON sample + Node/TS client snippet demonstrating backpressure and tool_call ordering (due EOD tomorrow). 2) Lucy to prepare security mitigation note (hosted vs private) and SAML checklist. 3) Frank to collect pricing ranges and commit thresholds and send to procurement. 4) Ask customer if they require strict JSON arrays per chunk or single-object-per-chunk.
frank_sales: I'll ask procurement and push for a start-date next Monday.
omar khan: Snippet I'll include (minimal):
```js
const s = await Redwood.stream.connect({key: process.env.RW});
s.on('message', m => { const obj = JSON.parse(m); switch(obj.type){ case 'row': renderRow(obj.payload); break; case 'tool_call': handleTool(obj.payload); break; }});
// backpressure: send ack every 50 rows
function sendAck(seq){ s.send(JSON.stringify({type:'ack',seq})); }
// example tool call
s.send(JSON.stringify({type:'tool_call',id:'t1',name:'payments.lookup',args:{acct:'A123'}}));
```
jen wong: Good. Keep thread updated. If they request sample infra creds, ping infra-bot for ephemeral project keys. :thumbsup:
